required_tests.evidence: Three genuine API35 Chromium device methods pass, including target=_blank with JavaScript on/off, all eight JavaScript/automatic-popup/multiple-window flag combinations, automatic window.open and genuinely user-activated scripted window.open. Native DOM touch, userActivation and actual document/title/network assertions are used, not injected onCreateWindow calls. Engine-blocked script requests do not fabricate events; true multiple-window mode records rejection, false mode follows documented Android current-view navigation.
required_tests.original_requirement: target=_blank link and user-initiated/scripted window.open with JavaScript/settings combinations.

required_tests.evidence: Deny-only is the explicitly chosen original recommended policy: same-origin, a different owned HTTP-server origin and nativecmpkit-untrusted:// links all produce a bounded observable rejection without parent navigation, child creation or a cross-origin request. No popup origin/scheme is accepted under this policy, no destination is guessed and no external handler or transport is delivered. Raw supportMultipleWindows=false intentionally bypasses child interception and has no promised origin filtering; managed login/payment child-window UI remains unsupported.
required_tests.original_requirement: Accepted and denied popup origins/schemes yield documented outcomes.

required_tests.evidence: Rejected windows create no child to close; the actual mounted native container retains one owner. Genuine native BACK input preserves parent history and also returns from the documented current-view fallback. Replacement releases the old native parent/state, keeps the two settings owners independent, and final disposal clears each native reference/parent with exactly-once disposal. Both owned HTTP workers terminate. Three fresh Robolectric host methods separately verify stale/detached/uninitialized callbacks, zero transport delivery, and 1000 bounded latest-state events without reapplying settings. This verifies owned lifecycle behavior, not a heap-profile or physical/minimum-device certification.
required_tests.original_requirement: Child window closure, back navigation and dispose release all resources.

retained_limitations: Actual API35 x86_64 Enforcing emulator/Chromium only; no physical/minimum Android or other engine/version certification.
Managed child-window/login/payment UI intentionally unsupported. The optional raw false flag is current-view navigation, not deny-only or trusted origin filtering.
Latest metadata is bounded, UI-thread only, nonpersistent and not a security token or exactly-once event stream. No heap/ABI/packaged consumer/dependency/legal/security/release gate cleared.
